inventory_state: Compact lossless source requirement matrix; not a complete normalized behavioral denominator
required_semantic_dedup_remaining: Dialog handlers and option interaction fixtures
Bundled utility version-specific behavior and actual distribution reconciliation
format: Rows omit shared defaults. Expected behavior defaults to behavior, owner to family, command identifier to row id. Acceptance template + suffix/when expands each original case losslessly; scripts/capability_matrix.py provides the reader.

row_defaults.classification_basis: Frozen source control/configuration plus full-capability contract; control presence does not prove implementation.
known_differences: Source requirements only; runtime and complete interaction combinations not verified.
row_defaults.mac_behavior: Native control or documented equivalent; behavioral details require implementation and focused source review.

command_contract_defaults.parameters: See row parameters and reference handler; unresolved values must not be guessed.
command_contract_defaults.availability: Native equivalent and source preconditions must be reviewed.
command_contract_defaults.recording_policy: Not approved for recording until text/view/external-effect classification is reviewed; external effects require explicit invocation.

automation_requirements.behavior: Rename and reload preserve stable UUID, saved steps, parameters and shortcut/toolbar bindings; names never choose behavior.
Unknown or malformed workflow versions fail safely without execution.
Selection input captures only selected bytes and revision; never changes whole document.
Rich clipboard text can be explicitly extracted as plain text; ordinary paste remains ordinary.
Document input captures authoritative text and revision.
User-chosen file input reads data without executing file content.
Ordered typed steps preserve saved and ask-at-run parameters through serialization.
Preview permits editing included item rows before committing output.
Cancel leaves editor, clipboard, files and external destinations unchanged.
Menu, shortcut, pinned toolbar, palette and context action invoke the same saved ID/version.
Shortcut conflicts are visible and cannot silently steal existing commands.
Editor transform applies through Scintilla as one Undo operation; stale revisions are rejected.
Explicit clipboard output writes only the reviewed transformed content.
Explicit file output uses native destination choice and safe failure handling.
New-document output creates an editable unsaved native document.
2 eggs, ½, 1½, 1/2, ranges, units, accented names and punctuation survive cleanup.
Only recognized list markers are removed; quantity-leading rows are not numbered-list markers.
Duplicates remain unless an explicit deduplication step is configured.
Ambiguous wrapping/headings remain reviewable; no automatic quantity scaling or merging.
Show selected writable list identifier plus name/account/source; duplicate names remain distinguishable.
Request access only on need; denied/revoked access and missing/read-only/deleted destinations do not write.
Only explicit reviewed send creates one reminder per included row.
Report per-row success/failure/uncertainty, retaining unsent/uncertain rows.
Double invocation and retries cannot silently duplicate a batch; uncertain outcomes do not promise exactly-once.
Editor Undo never implies external reminders were deleted.
Actual system access requires explicit consent and a designated scratch list; fake tests remain labeled fake.
Workflow import/rename/open never executes commands; explicit invocation and configured argv/shell mode required.
Recorded editing macros retain their independent record/save/replay/repeat behavior and may be called by configured steps.
